preflight.config.missing_section: Configuration is missing the required {section} section.
preflight.config.load_failed: Configuration could not be loaded. Review the organization configuration source.
jobs.blocker.unknown: An unknown blocker is preventing apply.
jobs.blocker.config_or_connectivity: Fix organization configuration or connectivity errors before running apply.
jobs.blocker.latest_dry_run_failed: The most recent dry run did not complete successfully. Re-run dry run after fixing errors.
jobs.blocker.no_successful_dry_run: No successful dry run has been recorded for this organization yet.
jobs.blocker.open_conflicts: Resolve the {count} open conflicts before running apply.
jobs.blocker.review_required: Latest high-risk dry run still needs review approval before apply can continue.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.no_stabl: No stable AD candidate is available for {source_id}; skip this user until identity is clarified.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.prefer_s: Prefer {candidate_username} because it matches the source user ID directly.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.prefer_e: Prefer {candidate_username} because it matches the source email local part.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.prefer_s: Prefer {candidate_username} because it is the strongest remaining identity match.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.no_revie: No reviewable AD account is available for {source_id}; skip this user until identity is clarified.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.bind_sou: Bind {source_id} to {candidate_username} because it matches the source user ID directly.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.bind_con: Bind {source_id} to {candidate_username} after review because it is the configured existing AD match.
conflicts.recommendation.reason.shared_a: AD account {target_key} is shared by multiple source users{related_users_suffix}. Safest default is to skip syncing {source_id} until a unique AD identity is assigned.
conflicts.message.multiple_ad_candidates: Source user {source_id} matched multiple AD candidates{candidates}.
conflicts.message.existing_ad_identity_c: Source user {source_id} matched existing AD account {target_key} and requires identity claim review.
conflicts.message.shared_ad_account: AD account {target_key} matched multiple source users{source_users}.
conflicts.message.generic: Identity conflict for {source_id}; review the job details before continuing.
conflicts.resolution.multiple_ad_candida: Create a manual identity binding before rerunning synchronization.
conflicts.resolution.existing_ad_identit: Approve a manual identity binding, or switch the first-sync identity claim policy to auto-claim safe existing AD matches.
conflicts.resolution.shared_ad_account: Create unique manual identity bindings for the affected users before rerunning synchronization.
conflicts.resolution.generic: Review the conflict details and record an explicit identity decision before rerunning synchronization.
conflicts.decision.label.target_not_sele: Pick a target AD account first
conflicts.decision.label.already_bound_e: Already bound to another source user
conflicts.decision.label.reactivate_user: Reactivate and update existing AD account
conflicts.decision.summary.target_not_se: No AD account is selected yet, so the binding decision cannot be evaluated.
conflicts.decision.summary.protected_acc: {target_username} is marked as a protected directory account and should not be managed through synchronization.
conflicts.decision.summary.already_bound: {target_username} is already bound to {binding_owner}, so binding it here would keep the identity conflict unresolved.
conflicts.decision.summary.reactivate_us: The next sync should reactivate and update {target_username} under the current field ownership and OU placement rules.
conflicts.decision.summary.update_user: The next sync should update {target_username} under the current field ownership and OU placement rules.
conflicts.decision.summary.create_user: The next sync should create the managed AD account {target_username} under the current field ownership and OU placement rules.
conflicts.decision.note.choose_existing_: Choose one existing AD account before approving a binding decision.
conflicts.decision.note.choose_unprotect: Pick a user-managed AD account instead of a protected system identity.
conflicts.decision.note.resolve_existing: Resolve the existing binding first, or choose a different AD account.
conflicts.decision.note.disabled_without: The account is currently disabled, and automatic reactivation is off, so this will stay an update plan.
conflicts.decision.note.shared_account_r: This AD account is still shared with {shared_users}, so binding it here does not remove the shared-account risk.
conflicts.decision.note.clear_candidate_: Choosing one concrete AD account should clear this user's candidate ambiguity on the next sync run.
conflicts.decision.note.approve_existing: Approving this claim writes a manual binding, so the next sync can update the existing AD account instead of creating a duplicate managed account.
conflicts.decision.note.stable_identity: This binding should let the next sync proceed with one stable AD identity for the source user.
conflicts.decision.without_binding.multi: Without a binding, the multiple-candidate conflict remains open and the next sync does not automatically create a new managed account for this user.
conflicts.decision.without_binding.share: Without a new identity decision, the shared-account conflict remains open and this action cannot safely create a separate managed account.
conflicts.decision.without_binding.exist: Without claim approval, the existing AD account stays unbound and the review policy keeps this user in the conflict queue on the next sync run.
conflicts.decision.without_binding.gener: No automatic identity decision is applied yet, so the conflict stays pending for review.
conflicts.decision.note.multiple_matches: The system still sees more than one existing AD match for this source identity.
conflicts.decision.note.unique_identity_: A unique AD identity still needs to be chosen for each affected source user.
conflicts.decision.note.auto_safe_policy: Switching the policy back to auto-safe allows unique, unprotected existing-account claims to bind automatically.
conflicts.decision.routing_unavailable: Source routing details are temporarily unavailable. Review the connector configuration and try again.
conflicts.candidate.explanation.existing: This existing AD account matched the first-sync identity claim policy and is waiting for review.
conflicts.candidate.explanation.shared_a: This AD account is currently shared by multiple source users.
conflicts.candidate.explanation.generic: This candidate came from the job record; review its account state before choosing it.
